notes: Read SKILL.md and references/secrets.md, references/keys.md in full. TypeScript reference for Azure Key Vault secrets (@azure/keyvault-secrets) and keys/cryptography (@azure/keyvault-keys): authentication, set/get/list secrets, soft-delete/recover/purge, key creation and rotation, encrypt/decrypt/sign/wrap, backup/restore and RBAC permissions.

Tells the agent to `npm install @azure/keyvault-secrets @azure/identity` (SKILL.md:19, unpinned) and provides code that authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential to the user's own vault and reads, writes, deletes and purges secrets and keys. Medium because of the package install and because the code handles real secret values against a live service; acceptable because this is the official Microsoft SDK, handling the user's own secrets is the skill's stated purpose, and there is no instruction to send secrets anywhere other than the user's Key Vault.

Users should know: samples print secret values to the console (SKILL.md:69, secrets.md:115), secrets.md:406-419 shows a bulk export of all secret values into memory, secrets.md:302-303 writes an (encrypted) backup blob to a local file, and purge examples (SKILL.md:98, secrets.md:281-286, keys.md:273) are irreversible; an agent should confirm with the user before running deletes/purges against a real vault. SKILL.md:44 uses KeyClient/@azure/keyvault-keys without installing or importing it.
